comparison.method: Box edge maximum = max of four absolute edge deltas. Browser baselines measured with an inline zero-height marker in each text run; native baselines from Label font ascent and vertical alignment. Composite text runs share their actual native baseline. R20 uses alpha=0.5 traced vector contours.

ink.method: Real Godot isolated paint captures from the production mesh renderer, registered with actual Control rectangles; source alpha unmixed from PNG palettes and independently positioned with approved Chromium DOM rectangles. Same-pigment layers form a set union before color compositing. Threshold 0.5; IoU on occupied pixels; symmetric Hausdorff on all boundary pixels, including every disconnected fleck and hole. Frame clipping and actor-heading paper backing retained. Full textured/glyph screenshot MAE is reported separately. Text test compares to the reference envelope with the 1.5px boundary allowance; R17 also verifies foreground stacking for every roster label.

performance.method: Fresh browser contexts, no prior battle/ink load. CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate rate=4 before navigation. A contiguous synchronous timer covers first resource load/decompression plus compilation and GPU buffer submission of all three initially visible assets. End is render-ready mesh/cache creation; normal first-paint frame scheduling and unrelated battle UI are excluded. No texture baking or GPU readback. OS.get_static_memory_usage brackets the same ink-only work; release export has this counter disabled, so debug export measures static allocation separately. Packed-array and initial mesh buffer byte counts are exact payload sizes, exclude allocator/dictionary/GPU driver overhead. No network time: data is already in mounted PCK.
